# HONOR Italia

> Official HONOR Italy website providing HONOR smartphones, laptops, tablets, wearables, audio products, accessories, and customer support resources.

## Company Information

- [About HONOR](https://www.honor.com/it/brand/): Official information about HONOR’s brand, mission, innovation, and corporate background.
- [HONOR News](https://www.honor.com/it/news/): Official HONOR Italy news, press releases, announcements, and product launch updates.
- [HONOR Blog](https://www.honor.com/it/blog/): HONOR product insights, buying guides, technology articles, and feature highlights.

## Product Categories

- [Laptops](https://www.honor.com/it/laptops/): HONOR MagicBook laptops designed for productivity, portability, and high performance.
- [Smartphones](https://www.honor.com/it/phones/): HONOR smartphones including flagship, foldable, and mid-range devices.
- [Tablets](https://www.honor.com/it/tablets/): HONOR tablets built for entertainment, education, and professional use.
- [Wearables](https://www.honor.com/it/wearables/): HONOR smartwatches and fitness bands for health tracking and smart connectivity.
- [Audio](https://www.honor.com/it/audio/): HONOR wireless earbuds and audio devices with advanced sound technology.
- [Accessories](https://www.honor.com/it/accessories/): Official HONOR chargers, cables, cases, and accessories.

## HONOR Store

- [HONOR Store](https://www.honor.com/it/shop/): Official HONOR Italy online store for purchasing HONOR products and accessories.

## Support Center

- [Support Center](https://www.honor.com/it/support/): Official HONOR support resources including FAQs, troubleshooting, and customer service.

## HONOR Technology

- [MagicOS](https://www.honor.com/it/magic-os/): HONOR intelligent operating system featuring AI-enhanced system capabilities.

## Sitemap

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.honor.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for HONOR website navigation and structured content discovery.

<script id="giftOutStocklist-temp" type="text/html">
    <p class="gift_stock_sub_title">Please kindly be advised our limited gifts are currently running out of stock, please agree and click "Continue to buy" option to proceed the order without the gifts.</p>
    {{each giftHtmlData giftGroup i}}
        {{if giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv}}
            <div class="groupdiv giftgroup groupdiv-outofstock"
                data-prdid="{{giftGroup.prdId}}" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="giftOutOfDtockPop{{i}}">
                <div class="groupitem groupitem-gift d-flex flex-column justify-content-center">
                    <div class="image-and-namecolor d-flex align-items-center">
                        <div class="groupitem-imglink align-self-start">
                            <a target="_blank" href="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].pdpLink}}" class="groupitem-link" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">
                                <img src="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].imgsrc}}" alt="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}">
                            </a>
                        </div>
                        <div class="groupitem-namecolorprice-box">
                            <div class="groupitem-namecolorprice groupitem-namecolorprice-gift d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start {{ (!giftGroup.colorShow && giftGroup.groupSkuList.length <= 1) ?'align-items-center':''}}">
                                <div class="groupitem-namecolorlist limit-width d-flex justify-content-center flex-column">
                                    <p class="groupitem-name">
                                        <a id="giftOutOfDtockPop{{i}}" target="_blank" href="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].pdpLink}}" class="groupitem-link font14-b"
                                        title="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}" tabindex="-1">{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}</a>
                                    </p>
                                    <div class="groupitem-colorbox">
                                        <a class="swiper-button-prev swiper-button-groupitemcolorlist" href="javascript:;"
                                        role="button" tabindex="-1"></a>
                                        <div class="groupitem-colorlist groupitem-colorlist-gift swiper-container {{(!giftGroup.colorShow && giftGroup.groupSkuList.length <= 1) ? 'hide':''}}">
                                            <ul class="groupitem-colorlist-ul swiper-wrapper">
                                                {{each giftGroup.groupSkuList itemObj j}}
                                                {{ if itemObj.sbomInventory>0 || giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv }}
                                                <li id="gift-skucode-{{itemObj.sbomCode}}"
                                                    class="groupitem-colorlist-li swiper-slide groupitem-colorlist-li-gift {{itemObj.sbomInventory<=0?'outofstock':''}}"
                                                    type="gift" itemType="G"
                                                    skuInv={{itemObj.sbomInventory}}
                                                    skuname="{{itemObj.sbomName}}"
                                                    oriprice={{itemObj.price}}
                                                    saleprice=0
                                                    qty="{{itemObj.quantity}}"
                                                    skucode={{itemObj.sbomCode}}
                                                    mainsku={{giftGroup.mainSkuCode}}
                                                    prdid={{itemObj.disPrdId}}
                                                    prdLink={{itemObj.pdpLink}}
                                                    imgsrc="{{itemObj.imgsrc}}"
                                                    title="{{itemObj.colorName}}"
                                                    giftattr="{{itemObj.giftAttr}}"
                                                    giftcolorattr="{{itemObj.giftColor}}"
                                                    giftmemoryattr="{{itemObj.giftMemory}}"
                                                    iscod="{{itemObj.isCod}}"
                                                    >
                                                    <div class="groupitem-colorItem" colorName="{{itemObj.colorName}}"
                                                        colorVal="{{itemObj.colorVal}}">
                                                        <p class="groupcolorItem">
                                                            <i class="color-val" style="background-color:{{itemObj.colorVal}}"></i>
                                                        </p>
                                                    </div>
                                                    {{if itemObj.energyEfficiencyData}}
                                                        {{@ imageHost | energyEfficiency itemObj.energyEfficiencyData true}}
                                                    {{/if}}
                                                </li>
                                                {{/if}}
                                                {{/each}}
                                            </ul>
                                        </div>
                                        <a class="swiper-button-next swiper-button-groupitemcolorlist" href="javascript:;"
                                        role="button" tabindex="-1"></a>
                                    </div>
                                    {{if giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv}}
                                            <span class="out-of-stock-span font12"><i> {{outOfStockText}} </i> </span>
                                    {{/if}}
                                </div>
                                <div class="groupitem-pricebtn d-flex">
                                    <div class="groupitem-price flex-column d-flex justify-content-center align-items-end">
                                        <span class="groupitem-saleprice font16-b">{{ 0 | ecCurrency}}</span>
                                        {{if !showEUPrice }}
                                        <span class="groupitem-oriprice del-line font14">{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].price | ecCurrency}}</span>
                                        {{/if}}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {{if giftGroup.energyEfficiencyData}}
                                {{@ imageHost | energyEfficiency giftGroup.energyEfficiencyData true}}
                            {{/if}}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        {{/if}}
    {{/each}}
</script>

<script id="giftOutStocklist-temp" type="text/html">
    <p class="gift_stock_sub_title">Please kindly be advised our limited gifts are currently running out of stock, please agree and click "Continue to buy" option to proceed the order without the gifts.</p>
    {{each giftHtmlData giftGroup i}}
        {{if giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv}}
            <div class="groupdiv giftgroup groupdiv-outofstock"
                data-prdid="{{giftGroup.prdId}}" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="giftOutOfDtockPop{{i}}">
                <div class="groupitem groupitem-gift d-flex flex-column justify-content-center">
                    <div class="image-and-namecolor d-flex align-items-center">
                        <div class="groupitem-imglink align-self-start">
                            <a target="_blank" href="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].pdpLink}}" class="groupitem-link" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">
                                <img src="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].imgsrc}}" alt="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}">
                            </a>
                        </div>
                        <div class="groupitem-namecolorprice-box">
                            <div class="groupitem-namecolorprice groupitem-namecolorprice-gift d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start {{ (!giftGroup.colorShow && giftGroup.groupSkuList.length <= 1) ?'align-items-center':''}}">
                                <div class="groupitem-namecolorlist limit-width d-flex justify-content-center flex-column">
                                    <p class="groupitem-name">
                                        <a id="giftOutOfDtockPop{{i}}" target="_blank" href="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].pdpLink}}" class="groupitem-link font14-b"
                                        title="{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}" tabindex="-1">{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].sbomName}}</a>
                                    </p>
                                    <div class="groupitem-colorbox">
                                        <a class="swiper-button-prev swiper-button-groupitemcolorlist" href="javascript:;"
                                        role="button" tabindex="-1"></a>
                                        <div class="groupitem-colorlist groupitem-colorlist-gift swiper-container {{(!giftGroup.colorShow && giftGroup.groupSkuList.length <= 1) ? 'hide':''}}">
                                            <ul class="groupitem-colorlist-ul swiper-wrapper">
                                                {{each giftGroup.groupSkuList itemObj j}}
                                                {{ if itemObj.sbomInventory>0 || giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv }}
                                                <li id="gift-skucode-{{itemObj.sbomCode}}"
                                                    class="groupitem-colorlist-li swiper-slide groupitem-colorlist-li-gift {{itemObj.sbomInventory<=0?'outofstock':''}}"
                                                    type="gift" itemType="G"
                                                    skuInv={{itemObj.sbomInventory}}
                                                    skuname="{{itemObj.sbomName}}"
                                                    oriprice={{itemObj.price}}
                                                    saleprice=0
                                                    qty="{{itemObj.quantity}}"
                                                    skucode={{itemObj.sbomCode}}
                                                    mainsku={{giftGroup.mainSkuCode}}
                                                    prdid={{itemObj.disPrdId}}
                                                    prdLink={{itemObj.pdpLink}}
                                                    imgsrc="{{itemObj.imgsrc}}"
                                                    title="{{itemObj.colorName}}"
                                                    giftattr="{{itemObj.giftAttr}}"
                                                    giftcolorattr="{{itemObj.giftColor}}"
                                                    giftmemoryattr="{{itemObj.giftMemory}}"
                                                    iscod="{{itemObj.isCod}}"
                                                    >
                                                    <div class="groupitem-colorItem" colorName="{{itemObj.colorName}}"
                                                        colorVal="{{itemObj.colorVal}}">
                                                        <p class="groupcolorItem">
                                                            <i class="color-val" style="background-color:{{itemObj.colorVal}}"></i>
                                                        </p>
                                                    </div>
                                                    {{if itemObj.energyEfficiencyData}}
                                                        {{@ imageHost | energyEfficiency itemObj.energyEfficiencyData true}}
                                                    {{/if}}
                                                </li>
                                                {{/if}}
                                                {{/each}}
                                            </ul>
                                        </div>
                                        <a class="swiper-button-next swiper-button-groupitemcolorlist" href="javascript:;"
                                        role="button" tabindex="-1"></a>
                                    </div>
                                    {{if giftGroup.prdAllColorNoInv}}
                                            <span class="out-of-stock-span font12"><i> {{outOfStockText}} </i> </span>
                                    {{/if}}
                                </div>
                                <div class="groupitem-pricebtn d-flex">
                                    <div class="groupitem-price flex-column d-flex justify-content-center align-items-end">
                                        <span class="groupitem-saleprice font16-b">{{ 0 | ecCurrency}}</span>
                                        {{if !showEUPrice }}
                                        <span class="groupitem-oriprice del-line font14">{{giftGroup.groupSkuList[0].price | ecCurrency}}</span>
                                        {{/if}}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            {{if giftGroup.energyEfficiencyData}}
                                {{@ imageHost | energyEfficiency giftGroup.energyEfficiencyData true}}
                            {{/if}}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        {{/if}}
    {{/each}}
</script>
